items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: He was from St. Charles or Lake Charles. He got killed in a fire.

ctx.x: Well yeah his style was more rough than I was. Rougher than you? Yeah. He's a hard clarinet player. Was he strong? He's pretty strong. But I got to lean on all of them. I didn't ask for it or say I had it. They gave it to me. On Hale I didn't know. After I was playing a whole lot of clarinet. And that time. They had a good little clarinet play some of them boys. I can't remember. Who were the ones that you liked especially? In clarinet? Well the one I liked in clarinet really was uh. I say for instance you say…
Walter Barnes was away? Where was he from? He was from St. Charles or Lake Charles. He got killed in a fire.
In Natchez. He was a clarinet player? Was he a good one? Good clarinet player.
